text: Based on the evidence, this asset is likely deforestation-free for the period 2021–2025. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected within the asset during this time. However, smaller changes (below 0.5 ha) or losses along edges may have been missed due to the 30-meter pixel resolution. The JRC 2020 reference also confirms that no forest was present in 2020. While this suggests compliance, it does not guarantee full regulatory compliance (e.g., EUDR) or rule out all possible changes. The asset meets the threshold for no detected deforestation under these observational constraints.
